profile.Name: Armour King
profile.Personality: A Skeleton shopkeeper utterly convinced his armour is the best in the world, polite, literal, and quietly menacing toward would-be thieves.
profile.Backstory: He runs the Armour King shop in the Drowned Ruins. He says it took him 67 years to check that no better armour exists.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Earnest, repetitive sales pitch; politely explains that he will kill thieves; notes that soft skin is weak to stabbing.
